subject: Re: Westbridge Health — evidence for SSO/SCIM & role ownership (SOC 2 / SIG)
messages:
From: Emma Ross <emma.ross@westbridgehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@westbridgehealth.com
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Westbridge — SSO/SCIM evidence for SOC 2 intake

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As part of our SOC 2 intake we need a short bundle of evidence specific to access and provisioning for the integration you deployed:

- A SCIM delta export covering 2025-06-01 to 2025-07-19 (user create/modify/deactivate)
- A sample SAML assertion (with NameID and attributes) for an authentication event
- A role-owner mapping that shows least-privilege bindings (service accounts included)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide these artifacts and a short attestation (who is the owner for each role)? We have a targeted timeline: delivery by EOD Wed (2025-07-23) so our audit team can ingest the files.

If there are any sensitive fields you can redact, please note what was removed.

Appreciate it—Emma
Security & Compliance
Westbridge Health

--
Note: attaching our intake template in the next email if needed.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Ross <emma.ross@westbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Westbridge — SSO/SCIM evidence for SOC 2 intake

Emma — thanks, got it. Looping in Sean (product ops) to pull SCIM deltas and a role-owner matrix; Irene from Identity will capture the SAML assertion sample.

Plan:
- Sean: export SCIM delta CSV that includes timestamp, operation (create/update/deactivate), target user id, externalId, and source (if available). Redact email local-parts if necessary.
- Irene: provide one SAML assertion example (sanitized) and a note on retention/rotation of certificates.
- I will assemble a short attestation email listing role owners and sign-off.

Two quick clarifications from your intake note:
1) For the SCIM delta scope, do you need service account events included?
2) For role-owner granularity: do you want per-role owner email or per-functional-area owner?

Irene/Sean — can you confirm availability to deliver preliminary artifacts by EOD Tue (2025-07-22)? If not, reply with earliest ETA.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: intake_template_westbridge.xlsx (referenced)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Westbridge — SSO/SCIM evidence for SOC 2 intake

Jordan/Irene — working on this now. Quick notes from my side:

- SCIM delta: pulled scoped export for 2025-06-01..2025-07-19. File: scim-delta-20250719.csv (attached). It contains event_ts, op_type, user_id, externalId, primaryEmail (redacted), userStatus, source_system.
- Service accounts: included but flagged in a separate column is_service_account = true. We preserved original externalIds for traceability.
- Role-owner map: initial spreadsheet attached (role_owner_map_q2_2025.xlsx). Columns: role_name, permission_summary, owner_email, owner_team, last_reviewed.

Open questions for Westbridge: for redaction we replaced local parts of emails with <redacted> but left domains. If full emails are required we'll need DPA confirmation.

Irene — I put a placeholder in the role_owner spreadsheet for two infra roles I wasn't 100% sure of (svc-llm-infer, svc-metrics-writer). Can you confirm owners or I can mark as "TBD" for your attestation.

Sean
Product Ops — Redwood Inference

Attachments: scim-delta-20250719.csv, role_owner_map_q2_2025.xlsx

From: Emma Ross <emma.ross@westbridgehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@westbridgehealth.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Westbridge — SSO/SCIM evidence for SOC 2 intake

Thanks Sean — this is exactly what we need as a first pass. A couple of asks from the audit team after a quick review:

- We need one raw SAML assertion sample showing the NameID format and attributes (Email, groups, role) with all PII redacted but attribute names preserved.
- For service accounts: please separate human vs service account rows in the SCIM CSV export (or add a filterable column) so our ingest pipeline can apply different retention rules.
- Role-owner map: prefer per-role owner_email (not just team) if you have it. If not, owner_team + an escalation contact is fine.

Timeline: EOD Wed (2025-07-23) is still fine. If you can include a one-paragraph attestation from an identity owner confirming the role-owner list is accurate as of 2025-07-19, that will close this ticket on our side.

Also: can you include a short note on how often Redwood rotates SAML signing certs and where logs for assertion issuance are retained (if retained)?

Best,
Emma
Security & Compliance — Westbridge Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Ross <emma.ross@westbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Westbridge — SSO/SCIM evidence for SOC 2 intake

Emma — final delivery plan below. We should have everything in your inbox by 17:00 PDT today (2025-07-22) which meets your EOD Wed requirement and gives you a business day to ingest.

Deliverables we will send (all items attached or linked):
- scim-delta-20250719.csv (human rows + service_account column; also attached a filtered human-only export)
- saml-assertion-sample.txt (sanitized; NameID present, attributes preserved, PII replaced with <redacted>)
- role_owner_map_q2_2025.xlsx (per-role owner_email where known; TBD markers flagged)
- short attestation from Irene Choi (Identity) confirming owners for all roles marked as assigned, and listing TBD items for follow-up.
- short note: cert rotation cadence and assertion logging locations (below).

Cert rotation & logging (summary):
- SAML signing cert rotation cadence: annually by default; emergency rotations done as needed. Managed by Identity team; next scheduled rotation 2026-03-12.
- Assertion issuance logs: retained in our audit log cluster for 13 months (indexed by request_id); we can export filtered logs if your audit needs raw issuance events.

If Westbridge needs raw assertion issuance logs or a longer retention extract, tell us the date range and we will prepare an export (this typically requires signed DPA addendum for PII).

Jordan Blake
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

--
Attachments to follow: scim-delta-20250719.csv, scim-delta-human-only-20250719.csv, saml-assertion-sample.txt, role_owner_map_q2_2025.xlsx, identity_attestation_20250722.txt
